briefs.label: Cannabis + Psychedelics
briefs.title: Hemp THC ban standoff hits Nov. 12 — as psychedelics get real
briefs.top: The federal hemp-THC ban's Nov. 12 deadline is a Senate-vs-House standoff threatening ~95% of hemp-THC products — while Colorado's ibogaine pilot took effect and Compass Pathways' psilocybin NDA tracks to Q4.

sections.name: 🌿 Cannabis

items.text: DEA rescheduling — post-hearing briefs filed Aug. 17; ALJ recommendation next.
Hemp THC ban — Nov. 12 deadline stands; THCA / D8-9 / vape brands on the clock.
Michigan — 24% wholesale-tax lawsuit at Court of Appeals w/ expedited review; ruling ~Sept. Prices nation's-lowest (~$8.49), demand steady.
Packaging — Village Farms' clear easy-pour pouches; premium glass/violet + QR/NFC labels trending.

sections.angle: If MI's 24% tax dies in September — do prices drop, or do operators pocket it?

sections.name: 🍄 Psychedelics

items.text: Colorado HB26-1325 (effective Aug. 12) adds a state ibogaine research pilot.
FDA finalized psychedelic guidance + Sept. 14 hearing; Compass COMP360 NDA on track for Q4.
DEA raised 2026 quotas: DMT 20k→25k g, 5-MeO-DMT 11k→30k g.
Reality check — a third of Oregon's licensed psilocybin centers have closed.

sections.angle: Psychedelics are getting federal traction faster than cannabis ever did — will weed get lapped?

briefs.why: The hemp-ban reformulation wave and emerging state-compliant mushroom packaging are both label & branding work landing in your lane — and it's ready-made Flower Room content.
